draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Gavi! Until 2012 hardly anyone had heard of this village. Then the Malayalam movie Ordinary was shot mostly here, and Gavi became a major tourist spot.
draft.hungryLine: Gavi is remote, the nearest railway station is 120 km away, so bring snacks and water with you.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk about 10 minutes to Gavi Dam, a small stone dam on the Gaviyar, a tributary of the Pamba.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit by the reservoir behind Gavi Dam and enjoy how far you are from everything.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The water here doesn't stay put. It's sent through a tunnel to the Meenar reservoir as part of the Sabarigiri power project.

spots.name: Gavi Dam
spots.detail: 10 min walk · Small masonry dam with a shared reservoir

spots.name: Konni Elephant Cage
spots.detail: 11 km from Pathanamthitta · Where wild elephants were once tamed

legends.title: The elephant cages
legends.body: In the past, wild elephants caught in the forests were brought to Konni and kept in wooden cages called Anakoodu. There they were tamed and trained for work.

legends.title: Famous on film
legends.body: Gavi was the main location for the Malayalam movie Ordinary. If the place looks familiar, that's probably why.

tips.title: Start early.
tips.body: Gavi is 28 km southwest of Vandiperiyar on forest roads, so give yourself plenty of daylight.

tips.title: Come by road.
tips.body: The nearest railway station is Thiruvalla, 120 km away, so plan on driving in.

story.title: Forest and elephants
story.body: The forests around Konni and Gavi were where wild elephants were caught. They were taken to Konni to be tamed in wooden cages.

story.title: A dam on the Gaviyar
story.body: Gavi Dam was finished as part of the Sabarigiri hydroelectric project, the second largest in Kerala. It's 17 metres high and 113 metres long.

story.title: Ordinary changes everything
story.body: The film Ordinary was mostly shot in Gavi. After its release the quiet village became a major tourist destination.
